rules.cwe_name: Data Processing Errors
rules.description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Request/Response Splitting')
rules.description: Writing user input directly to an HTTP header makes code vulnerable to attack by header splitting.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Unchecked Return Value
rules.description: Ignoring return values may result in discarding errors or loss of information.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: Use of a non-constant-time verification routine to check the value of an HTTP header, possibly allowing a timing attack to infer the header's expected value.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a potentially malicious tarball using `shutil.unpack_archive()` without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can cause files outside the destination directory to be overwritten. rules.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
rules.description: Leaving the SSL/TLS version unspecified may result in an insecure default protocol being used.

rules.cwe_name: Origin Validation Error
rules.description: Checking user supplied origin headers using weak comparators like 'string.startswith' may lead to CORS policy bypass.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.
